facebook.caption:
This place fixes a bad trip day.

The Beauty Bar sits on Ông Lang beach, away from the crowds, and it earns that 4.8★ across 486 reviews without a tourist-trap bone in its body. Food runs $15-30 a head. Cocktails land at golden hour. The vibe does the rest.

If your Phu Quoc itinerary has nothing this slow on it, fix that.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
